<!doctype html>

  <style>
    :root,[data-theme="light"]{
      --text-xs:clamp(.75rem,.7rem + .2vw,.82rem);
      --text-sm:clamp(.85rem,.8rem + .3vw,.95rem);
      --text-base:clamp(1rem,.96rem + .2vw,1.075rem);
      --text-lg:clamp(1.1rem,1rem + .55vw,1.35rem);
      --text-xl:clamp(1.45rem,1.15rem + 1.1vw,2.05rem);
      --text-2xl:clamp(1.95rem,1.35rem + 2.2vw,3.15rem);
      --sp-1:.25rem;--sp-2:.5rem;--sp-3:.75rem;--sp-4:1rem;--sp-5:1.25rem;--sp-6:1.5rem;--sp-8:2rem;--sp-10:2.5rem;--sp-12:3rem;--sp-16:4rem;
      --bg:#f4f2f6;--surface:#fdfcfe;--surface-2:#efeaf4;--border:#dbd2e6;--divider:#e7e0ef;
      --text:#211b28;--muted:#5f5769;--faint:#8a8194;--inverse:#f8f5fb;
      --purple:#4a2d63;--purple-2:#613d80;--purple-deep:#2c1a3d;--purple-tint:#e6dcf0;
      --gold:#b18a42;--gold-soft:#cbb06f;--gold-line:#c9ab63;
      --shadow-sm:0 1px 2px rgba(30,20,40,.06);--shadow-md:0 10px 30px rgba(30,20,40,.09);--shadow-lg:0 20px 48px rgba(30,20,40,.14);
      --r-sm:.35rem;--r-md:.7rem;--r-lg:1rem;--r-xl:1.35rem;--r-full:9999px;
      --font-display:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
      --font-body:'Source Sans 3',system-ui,Arial,sans-serif;
      --content:1140px;
    }
    [data-theme="dark"]{
      --bg:#16121c;--surface:#1e1826;--surface-2:#261e33;--border:#3c3049;--divider:#2e2539;
      --text:#ece3f2;--muted:#b6abc4;--faint:#897f97;--inverse:#f8f5fb;
      --purple:#9a7bb8;--purple-2:#b298cd;--purple-deep:#120d17;--purple-tint:#2b2138;
      --gold:#cdb06f;--gold-soft:#d9c288;--gold-line:#8a6f38;
      --shadow-sm:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3);--shadow-md:0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.4);--shadow-lg:0 20px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
    }
    *,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
    html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
    body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:var(--text-base);line-height:1.68;color:var(--text);background:var(--bg);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
    img,svg{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto}
    a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
    button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
    :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:3px}
    h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--font-display);line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 .6rem;font-weight:600}
    h1{font-size:var(--text-2xl);letter-spacing:.005em}
    h2{font-size:var(--text-xl)}
    h3{font-size:var(--text-lg)}
    p{margin:0 0 1rem}

    .skip-link{position:absolute;left:-9999px;top:auto}
    .skip-link:focus{left:1rem;top:1rem;z-index:1000;background:var(--surface);padding:.7rem 1rem;border-radius:var(--r-md);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md)}
    .wrap{width:min(calc(100% - 2.5rem),var(--content));margin-inline:auto}
    .eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:var(--text-xs);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase}
    .eyebrow::before{content:"";width:1.6rem;height:1px;background:var(--gold-line)}
    .lead{color:var(--muted);max-width:64ch}

    /* ---- Top bar ---- */
    .topbar{background:var(--purple-deep);color:var(--inverse);font-size:var(--text-xs);letter-spacing:.02em}
    .topbar .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:var(--sp-3);flex-wrap:wrap;padding:.6rem 0}
    .topbar a{color:var(--gold-soft)}
    .topbar a:hover{color:#fff}

    /* ---- Header ---- */
    header.site{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bg) 90%,transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--divider)}
    .nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:var(--sp-5);padding:.85rem 0}
    .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--sp-3);min-width:0}
    .brand-crest{flex:0 0 auto;height:48px;width:auto}
    .brand-text strong{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.16rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.05}
    .brand-text span{display:block;font-size:var(--text-xs);color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.03em}
    .mainnav ul{display:flex;gap:var(--sp-5);list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;flex-wrap:wrap}
    .mainnav a{font-size:var(--text-sm);font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);padding-bottom:2px;border-bottom:1.5px solid transparent}
    .mainnav a:hover{color:var(--purple);border-bottom-color:var(--gold-line)}
    .hdr-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--sp-3)}
    .theme-toggle{width:42px;height:42px;flex:0 0 auto;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface);cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:1rem}
    .theme-toggle:hover{border-color:var(--gold-line)}
    .menu-toggle{display:none;width:42px;height:42px;flex:0 0 auto;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--surface);cursor:pointer;place-items:center;color:var(--text)}
    .menu-toggle svg{width:20px;height:20px}
    .menu-toggle:hover{border-color:var(--gold-line)}
    main section{scroll-margin-top:92px}


    /* ---- Buttons ---- */
    .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:46px;padding:.8rem 1.3rem;border-radius:var(--r-full);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:var(--text-sm);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.01em;border:1.5px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease,background .15s ease}
    .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
    .btn-gold{background:var(--gold);color:#241a08;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
    .btn-gold:hover{background:var(--gold-soft)}
    .btn-outline{background:transparent;color:var(--purple);border-color:var(--purple)}
    .btn-outline:hover{background:var(--purple);color:var(--inverse)}
    .btn-ghost-light{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.28)}
    .btn-ghost-light:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16)}

    /* ---- Hero ---- */
    .hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;color:var(--inverse);min-height:clamp(30rem,64vh,42rem);background:var(--purple-deep)}
    .hero-img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 42%}
    .hero-scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(28,17,42,.93) 0%,rgba(28,17,42,.76) 34%,rgba(28,17,42,.50) 62%,rgba(28,17,42,.38) 100%)}
    .hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:3px;z-index:3;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,var(--gold-line),transparent)}
    .hero-content{position:relative;z-index:2;min-height:inherit;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:clamp(3.5rem,8vw,6rem) 0}
    .hero-copy{max-width:44ch}
    .hero .eyebrow{color:var(--gold-soft)}
    .hero h1{color:#fff;max-width:16ch;text-shadow:0 2px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.42)}
    .hero p{color:rgba(248,245,251,.9);max-width:52ch;text-shadow:0 1px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.42)}
    .hero-actions{display:flex;gap:var(--sp-3);flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:var(--sp-6)}
    .emblem{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--surface),var(--bg));border:1px solid rgba(201,171,99,.55);border-radius:var(--r-xl);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);padding:var(--sp-8) var(--sp-6);text-align:center;position:relative;animation:rise .8s ease both}
    .emblem::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:.6rem;border:1px solid rgba(201,171,99,.45);border-radius:calc(var(--r-xl) - .5rem);pointer-events:none}
    .emblem-crest{width:min(190px,72%);height:auto;margin:.2rem auto 1.1rem;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 6px rgba(30,20,40,.14))}
    .emblem h3{color:var(--purple-deep);margin-bottom:.15rem;font-size:1.45rem}
    .emblem .sub{color:var(--purple);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:var(--text-xs);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase}
    @keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

    /* ---- Quick facts strip ---- */
    .facts{background:var(--surface-2);border-top:1px solid var(--gold-line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--divider)}
    .facts .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:var(--sp-6);padding:var(--sp-8) 0}
    .fact strong{display:block;font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:var(--text-xs);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--purple);margin-bottom:.3rem}
    .fact span{color:var(--muted);font-size:var(--text-sm);line-height:1.5}

    /* ---- Generic section ---- */
    .section{padding:clamp(3rem,7vw,5rem) 0}
    .band{background:var(--surface-2)}
    .band-deep{background:var(--purple-deep);color:var(--inverse)}
    .band-deep .lead{color:rgba(248,245,251,.82)}
    .sec-head{max-width:66ch;margin-bottom:var(--sp-8)}
    .sec-head .eyebrow{color:var(--gold)}
    .band-deep .sec-head .eyebrow{color:var(--gold-soft)}
    .band-deep h2{color:#fff}

    .grid-2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:var(--sp-6)}
    .grid-3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:var(--sp-6)}
    .card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-lg);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);padding:var(--sp-6)}
    .card h3{color:var(--purple)}
    .card p{color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:0}
    .card.accent{position:relative;overflow:hidden}
    .card.accent::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;bottom:0;width:3px;background:linear-gradient(var(--gold-line),transparent)}

    /* ---- Patrona block ---- */
    .patrona{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;gap:var(--sp-10);align-items:center}
    .patrona-art{background:none;border:0;box-shadow:none;padding:var(--sp-4);text-align:center;position:relative}
    
    .patrona-art img{width:min(210px,82%);margin:0 auto 1rem;filter:none}
    .patrona-art .feast{font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:var(--text-xs);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--purple)}
    .patrona blockquote{margin:0 0 1.1rem;padding-left:1.1rem;border-left:2px solid var(--gold-line);font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:var(--text-lg);color:var(--text);font-style:italic}

    /* ---- Table ---- */
    .table-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-lg);box-shadow:var(--shadow-md);overflow:hidden}
    table.sched{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}
    table.sched caption{text-align:left;padding:1.1rem 1.3rem;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--purple);border-bottom:1px solid var(--divider)}
    table.sched th,table.sched td{padding:.95rem 1.3rem;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid var(--divider);vertical-align:middle}
    table.sched thead th{font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:var(--text-xs);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);background:var(--surface-2)}
    table.sched tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
    table.sched td:first-child{font-weight:600;color:var(--text)}
    table.sched td:last-child{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--muted)}

    /* ---- Notice ---- */
    .notice{display:flex;gap:var(--sp-4);align-items:flex-start;padding:var(--sp-5) var(--sp-6);border-radius:var(--r-lg);background:linear-gradient(90deg,color-mix(in srgb,var(--gold) 14%,var(--surface)),var(--surface));border:1px solid var(--gold-line)}
    .notice .mark{flex:0 0 auto;width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--purple);color:#fff}
    .notice strong{color:var(--purple);display:block}
    .notice p{margin:.2rem 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:var(--text-sm)}

    /* ---- Forms ---- */
    .split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.92fr 1.08fr;gap:var(--sp-6);align-items:start}
    .req-list{display:grid;gap:var(--sp-3);margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none}
    .req-list li{padding:var(--sp-4);border-radius:var(--r-md);background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--border)}
    .req-list strong{color:var(--purple);display:block;margin-bottom:.15rem}
    .req-list span{color:var(--muted);font-size:var(--text-sm)}
    form.pf{display:grid;gap:var(--sp-4)}
    form.pf label{display:block;font-size:var(--text-sm);font-weight:700;color:var(--text)}
    form.pf input,form.pf select,form.pf textarea{width:100%;margin-top:.4rem;padding:.85rem 1rem;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-md)}
    form.pf input:focus,form.pf select:focus,form.pf textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--purple);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--purple-tint)}
    form.pf textarea{min-height:130px;resize:vertical}
    .form-note{font-size:var(--text-xs);color:var(--faint);margin:0}
    .hp-field{position:absolute!important;left:-10000px!important;top:auto!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;overflow:hidden!important;opacity:0!important;pointer-events:none!important}
    .required-note{font-size:var(--text-xs);color:var(--muted);margin:-.25rem 0 .25rem}
    .required-mark{color:var(--purple);font-weight:800}
    form.pf .check{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:.7rem;font-size:var(--text-xs);font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.45}
    form.pf .check input{width:auto;min-width:1rem;height:1rem;margin:.18rem 0 0;padding:0;accent-color:var(--purple)}
    form.pf .check a{color:var(--purple);font-weight:700;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}
    .table-scroll{overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
    .privacy-box{margin-top:var(--sp-8);padding:var(--sp-5);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--r-md);background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--muted);font-size:var(--text-sm)}
    .privacy-box h3{color:var(--purple);margin:1.4rem 0 .5rem;font-size:var(--text-base)}
    .privacy-box h3:first-child{margin-top:0}
    .privacy-box p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}

    /* ---- Contact data ---- */
    .cdata p{margin:0 0 .7rem;color:var(--muted)}
    .cdata p strong{color:var(--text)}
    .cdata a{color:var(--purple);font-weight:600}
    .cdata a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
    .inst-tag{margin-top:var(--sp-4);padding-top:var(--sp-4);border-top:1px solid var(--divider);font-size:var(--text-xs);color:var(--faint);letter-spacing:.02em}

    /* ---- Footer ---- */
    footer.site{background:var(--purple-deep);color:var(--inverse);padding:var(--sp-12) 0 var(--sp-8)}
    .foot-top{display:flex;gap:var(--sp-5);align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-bottom:var(--sp-6);margin-bottom:var(--sp-6);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)}
    
    .foot-title strong{display:block;font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:1.2rem}
    .foot-title span{display:block;font-size:var(--text-xs);color:rgba(248,245,251,.7);letter-spacing:.02em}
    .foot-grid{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:var(--sp-6);flex-wrap:wrap;color:rgba(248,245,251,.82);font-size:var(--text-sm)}
    .foot-grid a{color:var(--gold-soft)}
    .foot-grid a:hover{color:#fff}
    .foot-feast{color:var(--gold-soft);font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-size:1.05rem}

    /* ---- Visita apostólica ---- */
    .band-deep .eyebrow{color:var(--gold-soft)}
    .visita-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.12fr .88fr;gap:var(--sp-10);align-items:center}
    .visita-figure{margin:0}
    .visita-figure img{width:100%;border-radius:var(--r-md);border:1px solid rgba(201,171,99,.5);box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.42)}
    .visita-quote{margin:0 0 var(--sp-4);padding-left:1.1rem;border-left:2px solid var(--gold-line);font-family:var(--font-display);font-size:var(--text-lg);font-style:italic;color:#fff;line-height:1.35}
    .visita-sign{font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;color:var(--gold-soft);font-size:1.15rem;margin:0}
    /* ---- Convocatorias / documentos ---- */
    .docs{display:grid;gap:var(--sp-3)}
    .doc{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:var(--sp-5);flex-wrap:wrap;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-left:3px solid var(--gold-line);border-radius:var(--r-md);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);padding:var(--sp-5)}
    .doc-main{min-width:0;flex:1 1 340px}
    .doc-main h3{color:var(--purple);margin:0 0 .2rem;font-size:var(--text-lg)}
    .doc-meta{font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:var(--text-xs);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--faint);margin:0 0 .35rem}
    .doc-main p:last-child{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:var(--text-sm)}
    .doc .btn{flex:0 0 auto}
    .docs-empty{color:var(--faint);font-style:italic;padding:var(--sp-4) 0}

    /* ---- Responsive ---- */
    @media (max-width:940px){
      .hero-content{padding:clamp(3rem,11vw,4.5rem) 0}
      .hero h1{max-width:none}
      .hero-scrim{background:linear-gradient(158deg,rgba(28,17,42,.92) 0%,rgba(28,17,42,.60) 100%)}
      .patrona{grid-template-columns:1fr}
      .visita-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
      .facts .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
      .grid-3{grid-template-columns:1fr}
      .grid-2,.split{grid-template-columns:1fr}
      .nav{flex-wrap:wrap}
      .brand{flex:1 1 280px}
      .menu-toggle{display:grid}
      .mainnav{display:none;order:3;width:100%;padding-top:.35rem}
      .mainnav.is-open{display:block}
      .mainnav ul{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;width:100%}
      .mainnav li{width:100%}
      .mainnav a{display:block;width:100%;padding:.72rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--divider)}
      .mainnav li:last-child a{border-bottom:0}
      table.sched{min-width:600px}
    }
    @media (max-width:520px){
      .facts .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
      .foot-grid{flex-direction:column;gap:var(--sp-3)}
      .wrap{width:min(calc(100% - 1.5rem),var(--content))}
      .brand-text span{display:none}
      .brand-crest{height:42px}
      .topbar .wrap{display:block}
      .topbar .wrap span{display:block}
      .topbar .wrap span+span{margin-top:.25rem}
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
      *,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
      html{scroll-behavior:auto}
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <a class="skip-link" href="#contenido">Saltar al contenido</a>

  <div class="topbar">
    <div class="wrap">
      <span>Servicio de Asistencia Religiosa de las Fuerzas Armadas · Ejército del Aire y del Espacio</span>
      <span>Tel. <a href="tel:+34928440078">928 440 078</a> · <a href="mailto:parroquialoretomacan@gmail.com">parroquialoretomacan@gmail.com</a></span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <header class="site">
    <div class="wrap nav">
      <a class="brand" href="#contenido" aria-label="Inicio · Parroquia de Nuestra Señora de Loreto">
        <img class="brand-crest" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Emblema del Servicio de Asistencia Religiosa del Ejército del Aire y del Espacio">

    <section class="section band" id="privacidad">
      <div class="wrap">
        <div class="sec-head">
          <span class="eyebrow">Privacidad</span>
          <h2>Protección de datos personales</h2>
          <p class="lead">Información sobre el tratamiento de los datos facilitados a través de los formularios de esta página.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="privacy-box">
          <h3>Responsable del tratamiento</h3>
          <p>Parroquia de Nuestra Señora de Loreto del Mando Aéreo de Canarias — Servicio de Asistencia Religiosa de las Fuerzas Armadas (Arzobispado Castrense de España). Dirección: C/ Góngora, 3, Las Palmas de Gran Canaria. Correo: <a href="mailto:parroquialoretomacan@gmail.com">parroquialoretomacan@gmail.com</a>. Teléfono: 928 440 078.</p>

          <h3>Finalidad</h3>
          <p>Atender las consultas remitidas a través del formulario de contacto y gestionar las solicitudes de certificados, incluida, en su caso, su expedición. Los datos no se emplean para ninguna finalidad distinta ni para comunicaciones comerciales.</p>

          <h3>Legitimación</h3>
          <p>El consentimiento del interesado, prestado al marcar la casilla de aceptación del formulario (artículo 6.1.a del RGPD). Cuando la solicitud de certificados revele datos relativos a las creencias religiosas —categoría especial de datos—, el tratamiento se basa en el consentimiento explícito del interesado (artículo 9.2.a del RGPD). El consentimiento puede retirarse en cualquier momento.</p>

          <h3>Destinatarios</h3>
          <p>Los datos se destinan exclusivamente a la atención de la consulta o solicitud por parte de la parroquia. Para el funcionamiento técnico de la página, la transmisión de los formularios y el correo electrónico pueden intervenir proveedores tecnológicos que prestan los servicios necesarios. No se comunican los datos a terceros para fines comerciales, sin perjuicio de las comunicaciones exigidas por una obligación legal.</p>

          <h3>Conservación</h3>
          <p>Los datos se conservan durante el tiempo necesario para atender la consulta o la solicitud y, en su caso, para expedir el certificado. Posteriormente se conservan, debidamente bloqueados, durante los plazos legalmente exigibles, y se suprimen cuando dejan de ser necesarios.</p>

          <h3>Derechos</h3>
          <p>Puede ejercer los derechos de acceso, rectificación, supresión, oposición, limitación del tratamiento y portabilidad dirigiéndose por escrito a <a href="mailto:parroquialoretomacan@gmail.com">parroquialoretomacan@gmail.com</a> o a la dirección postal indicada, acreditando su identidad. Si considera que el tratamiento no se ajusta a la normativa, tiene derecho a presentar una reclamación ante la Agencia Española de Protección de Datos (<a href="https://www.aepd.es" target="_blank" rel="noopener">www.aepd.es</a>).</p>

          <h3>Normativa aplicable</h3>
          <p>Reglamento (UE) 2016/679 (RGPD), Ley Orgánica 3/2018 de Protección de Datos Personales y garantía de los derechos digitales, y la normativa canónica de protección de datos que resulte de aplicación.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>

  <script>
    (function(){
      var root=document.documentElement;
      var themeBtn=document.querySelector('[data-theme-toggle]');
      var menuBtn=document.querySelector('[data-menu-toggle]');
      var nav=document.getElementById('menu-principal');

      function preferredDark(){
        try{
          var saved=localStorage.getItem('loreto-theme');
          if(saved==='dark') return true;
          if(saved==='light') return false;
        }catch(e){}
        return window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
      }

      var dark=preferredDark();
      function setTheme(isDark,save){
        dark=isDark;
        root.setAttribute('data-theme',isDark?'dark':'light');
        if(themeBtn){
          themeBtn.textContent=isDark?'☀':'☾';
          themeBtn.setAttribute('aria-label',isDark?'Cambiar a modo claro':'Cambiar a modo oscuro');
          themeBtn.setAttribute('title',isDark?'Cambiar a modo claro':'Cambiar a modo oscuro');
        }
        if(save){
          try{localStorage.setItem('loreto-theme',isDark?'dark':'light');}catch(e){}
        }
      }
      setTheme(dark,false);
      if(themeBtn){themeBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){setTheme(!dark,true);});}

      function closeMenu(){
        if(!nav||!menuBtn) return;
        nav.classList.remove('is-open');
        menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
        menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-label','Abrir menú');
      }
      if(menuBtn&&nav){
        menuBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){
          var open=nav.classList.toggle('is-open');
          menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',open?'true':'false');
          menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-label',open?'Cerrar menú':'Abrir menú');
        });
        nav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(link){link.addEventListener('click',closeMenu);});
        document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape') closeMenu();});
        window.addEventListener('resize',function(){if(window.innerWidth>940) closeMenu();});
      }

      /*
       * FORMULARIOS PARROQUIALES
       * Después de desplegar Code.gs como aplicación web de Google Apps Script,
       * sustituya UNA SOLA VEZ el texto entre comillas por la URL terminada en /exec.
       */
      var LORETO_FORM_ENDPOINT='https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzS0SVdedbr2qOruKcSPaX4dQCfdGfzTcw2qjcSjN_MCeGRym8mEyVp9A86nlks4_bd/exec';

      function setHidden(form,name,value){
        var input=form.querySelector('input[name="'+name+'"]');
        if(!input){
          input=document.createElement('input');
          input.type='hidden';
          input.name=name;
          form.appendChild(input);
        }
        input.value=value;
      }

      document.querySelectorAll('form[data-loreto-form]').forEach(function(form){
        if(LORETO_FORM_ENDPOINT.indexOf('https://script.google.com/macros/s/')===0 && /\/exec(?:$|\?)/.test(LORETO_FORM_ENDPOINT)){
          form.setAttribute('action',LORETO_FORM_ENDPOINT);
        }
        form.addEventListener('submit',function(e){
          if(!form.checkValidity()) return;
          if(!form.getAttribute('action')){
            e.preventDefault();
            alert('El envío del formulario todavía no está activado. Contacte con la parroquia en parroquialoretomacan@gmail.com.');
            return;
          }
          setHidden(form,'return_url',new URL('gracias.html',window.location.href).href);
          setHidden(form,'origin_url',window.location.href.split('#')[0]);

          var button=form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
          if(button){
            button.disabled=true;
            button.setAttribute('aria-busy','true');
            button.textContent=form.dataset.loretoForm==='certificado'?'Enviando solicitud…':'Enviando consulta…';
          }
        });
      });
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
